placements.title: Database and infrastructure architecture decisions form their own organizational category
placements.theme: Choices about core data-platform technology — which database, which query engine, which infrastructure underpins the pipeline — are architecture-grain decisions with lasting technical consequences, distinct from product or strategy framing.

placements.title: Adopting a columnar-optimized database reshapes the analytics pipeline's performance ceiling
placements.theme: Moving the analytics pipeline onto a columnar-query-optimized database is justified by order-of-magnitude performance gains and executed against a committed migration timeline, not adopted as an isolated tool swap.
